story_01002: Shh…be quiet! It might be another potential customer! Customers matter !
story_01004: Hi! Yeah, exactly you! I'm within your earshot.
story_01005: You're summoned by the Devil King as well? Huh, rescuing the Devil King from the warriors is quite a big deal!
story_01006: …Ha ha, don't be nervous… I'm <cr=230,65,5>Shanull<cr=def>, your soul elf!
story_01007: Hey.. Why you're in such a mess?! Tidy yourself up.
story_02001: Yeah, right.. not the priority at the moment. But how should I call you in case I forget it later. Maybe Minion?
story_03001: Am I the only one who think the monsters are getting tackier?
story_03002: Stop mumbling.. You know how insolent the warriors are... Monsters were left unpaid for several months. The lead tried to ask for a justified reason but…
story_03003: Let alone bringing the payroll back... The poor lead was now trapped in <cr=230,65,5>Ruling Tower<cr=def>. The only way out is to summon little monsters around. God knows how many of them went missing after their trek.
story_03004: …You've told it before like million times.
story_03006: Cough! <cr=230,65,5> and Uncle Guji<cr=def> are right. We have to bring the Devil King back…
story_03007: Well, let's head for the tower then. I'll show you everything on our way.
story_03008: I hope he could hold up to hear every detail. One more living monster, one more potential client....
story_05001: We are now in <cr=230,65,5>Ruling Tower<cr=def>! In short we conceived a 3-step rescue plan.
story_05002: Step 1: Cross the forest and sneak into the first floor of the tower, excatly where we are now.
story_05003: Step 3: Rush to the top floor and take <cr=230,65,5>Devil King Setek<cr=def> away!
story_05004: Now what need to be planned in detail is Step 2...
story_05005: See? Warriors are everywhere. You have to elevate your skills by killing them. The stairs to upper floor could be found here. We cannot get to the top without it, let alone rescuing the lead.
story_05006: Easy right? Start your journey by the 1st kill.
story_06001: Watch out! They're not rookies. You cannot evade attacks as we elves do. You may get hurt everytime you fight!
story_06002: Look at the bottom right corner.
story_06003: <cr=230,65,5>The red bar<cr=def> is your <cr=230,65,5>HP<cr=def>. If it lowers to zero, it means you need to get healed… Wait, no.. it means you're dead.
story_06004: The <cr=230,65,5>red bottle<cr=def> on the left is a HP potion. A bite of them can restore half of your HP. They will be recharged to 10 bottles everytime you enter the Ruling Tower, amazing right?
story_06005: Huh? of course I have never tried. Have you ever seen an injured elf? But you can try.
story_07001: Oh~ It looks like you have got a good <cr=230,65,5>equipment<cr=def>!
story_07201: It looks awesome. You are really a lucky little monster!
story_07202: As I just said, those warriors are tough. If you don't fight them without any better equipment, you'll die.
story_08001: Hey, you've found a <cr=230,65,5>stair<cr=def> and activated it! Climb up the stairs and get closer to the Devil King!
story_08002: Watch the stairs mark on the left upper corner.
story_08003: Once you have activated the stairs, you will never get lost in this stair wherever you run. If you want to return to the <cr=230,65,5>stairs<cr=def>, just click onto this icon.
story_09001: Hey, looks like you are much better than I thought! You have been climbing up several floors.
story_09002: Ha ha ha, don't be shy. I'm praising you!
story_09003: But remember, the higher you climb, the higher level the warriors will be! Find a warrior and <cr=230,65,5>hold<cr=def> on him to check his information.
story_10102: Eh? You know you've leveled up? Boring... But little monsters can modify their DNA by learning different <cr=230,65,5>skills<cr=def> after they upgrade!
story_10103: Yes, you've got one <cr=230,65,5>Gene Point<cr=def>. Want me to teach you how to remold yourself?
story10104_option1: I will not show off any more!
story_10105: Alright alright! Let me tell you... Click on the screen for three times and shake your phone for five times. Done.
story_10106: ...Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha. Alright, that's enough! Come on, click here.
story_10301: Do you see own monster gene? Here you can modify your DNA by using Gene Points to learn skills … Let's move on.
story_10401: Everytime you learn and upgrade a skill, you will consume 1 Gene Point. Choosing the most fittest skill to modify your DNA will make you a unique monster!
story_11001: Ha Ha. I was just kidding, you won't be mad right?
story_11002: You are different from other monsters. I would let you die. Heh heh!
story_12001: Hey hey… I said you are actually doing well. But sometime you need to check your bag if any new stuff is added to your backpack.
story_13004: <cr=230,65,5>Don't you know you'll die! Be more careful next time!!<cr=def>
story_14001: Well…Still go on? Are you sure you really don't need to find a way to get a supply as soon as possible? …
story_15001: Hey, seems you have known how the monster gene works. You've just learned a <cr=230,65,5>combat skill <cr=def>!
story_15002: This is a powerful skill that can be used in the fight, wow! I haven't seen for several days that a little monster can survive such long time to modify an active skill! Go find a warrior and have a try, heh heh!
story_16001: So let's see the so-called <cr=230,65,5>combat skill<cr=def>.
story_16002: This is the <cr=230,65,5>combat skill<cr=def> you've just learned. You can use it any time in the combat.
story_16003: The numbers below the skill diagram means your <cr=230,65,5> MP points <cr=def> consumed by this skill.
story_16004: This blue bar represents your <cr=230,65,5>MP points<cr=def>. You can't use the skill if you don't have enough MP.
story_16005: Like HP potion, <cr=230,65,5>MP potion<cr=def> can restore half of your MP points.
story_17001: Well, it looks like you've collected a lot, and your backpack is full.
story_17002: If you don't want this item, you can throw it away by clicking on the trash bin button on the left.
story_17003: But if you want to keep this item, you need to click on the <cr=230,65,5>clear button<cr=def> on the right to manage your backpack, so you can have more spaces for new items/equipment.
story_18001: You can click on the <cr=230,65,5>trash bin<cr=def> button above the items bar to discard items in the backpack one by one or in batch. You can also click the unlock button to <cr=230,65,5>buy more backpack space <cr=def>.

story_20002: Only the fully stats -- 100 energy points<cr=230,65,5>that you can take all items you just obtained in this adventure<cr=def> like golds, exp and all resources.
story_20003: If it wasn't 100 energy points enough I will make an exception to fill it up for you. We'll try it later.
story_20004: I just want to tell you how to get energy point, It's actually very simple, you can get charged by defeating warriors.
story_20005: Although you can also give up the adventure and return to camp from the setting interface, you will return to the state before entering the floor and this adventure will be a waste if you do that.
story_20006: Please remember that <cr=230,65,5>you can keep all the harvests only by the fully charged<cr=def>. You can leave at any time you want. So let's try it now, alright?
story_21004: Now I can understand why Gujiguji would risk to the tower to find you, what a beautiful Succubus ah, ha ha ha...
story_21006: Ah ha ha, it's all right. We are just looking around ~ let's go~.

story_22001: Bi, tell them about your plan of inlaid gems!

Chapter 1

“There hide endless wealth and power in [Ruling Tower]!”
A voice echoed throughout my soul all day long, which was nearly driving me crazy...
Today, I finally made up my mind to enter the [Ruling Tower]. Lucky me,there is neither troublesome human alliance adventurers nor rebel of the king's betrayal, hooo, meaning another fruitless day. I just dug out some local specialties with my little hoe, that's all.
Bless me, hope I can keep the good habit of taking notes!
diarydesc_1001:
Chapter 22

The voice still lingered inside me. I must find out who he is, and then give him my most merciless but fervid stab!
Why didn't I kill him at once? Cuz I'm gonna torture him day and night to let him feel what I've suffered !
Damn!I It's been a whole month since I entered the tower. My supplies are still sufficient, but the fights increasingly broke out. Human Union must have strengthened their armies.
Well, I'm not the only demon in battle!
Feel a bit messed up, but hope things will be better tomorrow...
diarydesc_1002:
Chapter 34

Oh!Holy crap! Isn't he ever getting tired? Blablablah, never ends! I truly need an outlet for my anger!
Lucky today,
I met a few "buddies" when I almost crashed.
But that's strange, I still felt insecured even though I know we are in the same boat ——Uh, perhaps that's how our demons are different from humans? Those "buddies" in the [Ruling Tower] seemingly acted in a quite restrained way, which is not that bad... After all, the biggest pressure comes from the human alliance. We made a friendly deal.
Genuinely friendly!I bought most of their supplies with just 1 copper! I unexpectedly seemed to get a secret power from the beep! They lay on the ground, showing loads of gratitude for I carried a lot weight away for them.
Thanks Lord, I felt much relaxed today. Hope that I can meet up with more "buddies" during my next adventure.……

Chapter 67

My mind is blown up——BOOM!\I gotta speed up to carry out my plan as I was still cognitiant. To write down some important clues so that my buddies were able to decode in the near future .
According to my survey,the beep sound deep down from the soul would gradually corroded our souls and will. Well, not that bad. It can relate to our souls thus stimulating the potential from ancient heroes.
Hmmm...there is currently no perfect solution for its side effect. Once you were accidentally lured by it, the only plausible way lies in being yourself. 
Time! Time! What I urgently need is time……

Humility, honesty, pity, gallantry, justice, sacrifFrost, honor, spirit, the creed of the Knights' self-discipline. It is known that the knight of the eight virtues.

diarydesc_1011:
Two

I shed tears for Kaff? What nonsense! I, the Wise Sinderaul, the type of person who are never bothered by trifles.
Truely I could recall the first time when I met Kaff. He was in such a glamarous suit, with obliged servants companied aside, his confidence and disposition find no way to hide  .
“What a precious resource! I must aquaintant myself with him!” The idea suddenly hit me.
diarydesc_1012:
Three

diarydesc_1013:
Four

Kaff, the family-grown knight, was eventually moved by my persistense and then formally invited me to be his knight attendant. In this way, my life has come to a turn.
Now, I am stepping into a new journey. The mighty Lord Kaff was... killed by a crazy monster because of his firm executive order.
Oh poor Kaff...

Mourinho always have a secret, he didn't tell anyone, including Cassava Nur. diarydesc_1043:
Diamonds（Two）

The diamond is mainly assessed from 4 aspects: weight, clarity, color and cut.
tWeight: the heavier the better
Clarity: the purer the better
Color: either the more transparent the better or the darker the better 
Cut: determine how glaring a diamond would be, 
How to assess: use a weapon of normal weight to gently cut the item. If traces appeared on it , it must be forged!
diarydesc_1044:
Ruby

Strictly speaking, the natural ruby is rare and precious.

diarydesc_1045:
Sapphire（One）

The great gemler, Mr. Bish Bos must confess a cruel truth to all dear readers: Only two types of gem exist in this world, the Ruby and the Sapphire.

It is worth mentioning that a great deal of natural gems resemble sapphire, which also renders the evaluation process much tougher. Indicolite, Sandwich stone, you name it, are all easily mistaken gems from sapphire.
